detail: Full summary: The placeholder-model-dir test cannot fail on the old code: with a fake cache transformers.js dies at tokenizer.json before any ONNX session exists, so no thread pool and exit 0 even with process.exit. It pins the cached-model branch only; the real-cache symlink test (it.skipIf when absent, live on dev machines, skipped in CI) is the actual regression guard — CI therefore does not cover the blocker; a dev-machine run does.
